items.exampleEn: This chart shows the weather for the week.
items.exampleZh: 這張圖表顯示這一週的天氣。

items.exampleEn: I fell asleep before the last chapter.
items.exampleZh: 我還沒看到最後一章就睡著了。

items.exampleEn: The exam was easier than I thought.
Can you give me a summary of the meeting?
items.exampleZh: 你可以給我這次會議的摘要嗎？

items.exampleEn: This dictionary is for English learners.
items.exampleZh: 這本字典是給英語學習者用的。
萬物都是由原子組成的。

items.exampleEn: Please pronounce it slowly for me.
Your vocabulary is getting bigger every week.
items.exampleZh: 你的字彙量每週都在增加。

items.sentenceEn: The exam starts at nine o'clock.

items.audioEn: For homework, read chapter five and write a summary.
items.audioZh: 作業是讀第五章，然後寫一段摘要。
options: Read chapter five and write a summary
Draw a chart of chapter five

items.sentenceEn: Some names are hard to pronounce.

items.stemEn: The book has twelve ____, and each one is about a different country.
items.stemZh: 這本書有十二章，每一章介紹一個不同的國家。

items.stemEn: I studied all night for the ____.
items.stemZh: 我為了考試讀了一整晚。

items.passageEn: Next week, Mia has a big science exam. She reads one chapter of her textbook every night. Then she writes a short summary and makes a chart of the important ideas. The hardest part is about atoms. While she studies, she drinks hot tea from her favorite mug. She also learns the new vocabulary and practices how to pronounce difficult words.
items.passageZh: Mia 下週有一場重要的自然科考試。她每天晚上讀一章課本，然後寫一段簡短的摘要，再把重要的概念整理成圖表。最難的部分是原子。她讀書時會用她最喜歡的馬克杯喝熱茶。她也背新的詞彙，練習怎麼唸難唸的字。

options: 放學後去附近的補習班上課
看電視上的自然科節目

questions.questionZh: 對 Mia 來說最難的是哪個部分？

referenceEn: I need to learn more vocabulary.
I need to learn more new vocabulary.
rubricZh: 「詞彙」用 vocabulary（不可數，不加 s）

items.instructionZh: 用 learner 造一個句子，說說你自己是怎樣的學習者。
referenceEn: I am a slow but careful learner.
I am a better learner in the morning.
rubricZh: learner 是可數名詞（例如 a fast learner、a careful learner）
說自己可寫例如 I am a … learner
